sourceSubject: Merged PR 19720: fix: #37855 add disable condition to button and methods in FinancialParametersForm component

requirements.behavior: Block Financial Parameters New/empty actions when form is disabled
requirements.rationale: ACP already disables the New button with saved || disable and early-returns in onShowAddNew/clickEmpty when disable is set.
requirements.impact: Read-only users cannot open add/empty flows via click when disable is true.
